meta.frames: body x fwd, y left, z up; pitch > 0 nose down; roll > 0 left up; q about body origin

assumptions.levelling_law: idealised (not C2): KZ 0.5, KP 0.2, KI 0.01, KTW 0.5 on n^T F_cyl / k_nom, filter 2 x 0.8 s, 10 Hz, delay 1, dead bands 0.03 deg / 1.5 mm / 2 kN
assumptions.crawler: C envelope, 20 mm grid, hull b (Chrono)
assumptions.pad: one flat element, swivel keeps it level
assumptions.k_leg: series(k_oil(e) + k_rod_side, k_rod, k_frame), dead length 0.05 m
